qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for coupling bolts for hydraulic pipes in the clutch operation system?
What torque should be applied when installing the master cylinder to console?
What is the specified torque for the master cylinder setscrew?
How much torque should be applied to the master cylinder to pedal assembly connection?
What is the torque specification for connecting the slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case?
Which component in the hydraulic clutch system has the lowest torque requirement?
qa_pairs.answer: Master cylinder to pedal assembly at 10 Nm

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are shown for the hydraulic clutch operation components?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different torque specifications: 10 Nm, 17 Nm, and 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle types do these hydraulic clutch torque specifications apply to?
Which clutch system components require 22 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Master cylinder to console, master cylinder setscrew, and slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case
